title: The 10-Minute AI Privacy Check-Up for ChatGPT and Claude
instagram:
Your AI chats are not as private as you think. 🤖

❌ Saved by default.
❌ Some can end up in training.
✅ 10 switches fix most of it.

Here is the 10-minute check-up for ChatGPT and Claude:

1️⃣ Choose the right plan
Business and team plans aren't trained on by default.

2️⃣ Turn off training
One switch in ChatGPT, one in Claude.

3️⃣ Skip chat feedback
A thumbs up/down can send the whole chat in.

4️⃣ Keep chats private
Lock chats in ChatGPT. Delete what you don't need.

5️⃣ Use temporary chat
Temporary in ChatGPT, incognito in Claude.

6️⃣ Turn off memory
Pause it, or wipe what it already saved.

7️⃣ Delete old shared links
Anyone with the link can still read them.

8️⃣ Check your Codex settings
Codex has its own training switch.

9️⃣ Audit your extensions
Disconnect apps and connectors you don't use.

🔟 Protect real secrets
No passwords, keys or card numbers in chats.

Every menu path is on the slides, checked against OpenAI's and Anthropic's own help pages.

You don't need to be a security expert. You need 10 minutes.
